results_note: Election held 7 Nov 2026. NZ First: 12 list seats, 0 electorate seats, 9.78% party vote (236,630). Special votes (~399,000) not yet counted; official result due 27 Nov 2026. Presumed-elected list order per Wikipedia Results page: 1 Peters, 2 Jones, 3 Costello, 4 Mark Patterson, 5 Alfred Ngaro, 6 Laws, 7 Hipango, 8 Stobo, 9 Randell, 10 Marcroft, 11 Foster, 12 David Wilson. Marcroft/Foster/Wilson are near the cut-off (13th is Jamie Arbuckle), so special votes could change this.
